sn11.5:1.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkaṃ devānam indam etad avoca || ||
sn11.5:1.4: Hotu devānam inda subhāsitena jayo ti || ||
sn11.5:1.6: Atha kho bhikkhave devā ca asurā ca pārisajje ṭhapesuṃ ||
sn11.5:1.7: ime no subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitam ājānissantī ti || || 5.
sn11.5:1.8: Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkaṃ devānam indam etad avoca || ||
sn11.5:1.10: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Vepacittim asurindam etad avoca || ||
sn11.5:1.13: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn11.5:3.1: Bhāsitāya kho pana bhikkhave Vepacittinā asurindena gāthāya asurā anumodiṃsu || devā tuṇhī ahesuṃ || || 9.
sn11.5:3.2: Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkaṃ devānam indam etad avoca || ||
sn11.5:3.4: Evam vutte bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn11.5:5.1: Bhāsitāya kho pana bhikkhave Sakkena devānam indena gāthāya devā anumodiṃsu || asurā tuṇhī ahesuṃ || || 12.
sn11.5:5.2: Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Vepacittim asurindam etad avoca || ||
sn11.5:7.1: Bhāsitāya kho pana bhikkhave Vepacittinā asurindena gāthāya asurā anumodiṃsu || devā tuṇhī ahesuṃ || || 14.
sn11.5:7.2: Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkaṃ devā. nam indam etad avoca || ||
sn11.5:7.4: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn11.5:14.1: Bhāsitāsu kho pana bhikkhave Sakkena devānam indena gāthāsu devā anumodiṃsu || asurā tuṇhī ahesuṃ || || 17.
sn11.5:14.2: Atha kho bhikkhave devānañ ca asurānañ ca parisajjā etad avocuṃ || || 18.
sn11.5:14.4: tā ca kho sadaṇḍāvacarā satthāvacarā iti bhaṇḍanam iti viggaho iti kalaho ti || || 19.
sn11.5:14.5: Bhāsitā kho Sakkena devānam indena gāthāyo ||
sn11.5:14.6: tā ca kho adaṇḍāvacarā asatthāvacarā iti abhaṇḍanam iti aviggaho iti akalaho ||
sn11.5:14.7: Sakkassa devānam indassa subhāsitena jayo ti || || 20.
sn11.5:14.8: Iti kho bhikkhave Sakkassa devānam indassa subhāsitena jayo ahosi || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || 2.
